_meta.owner: CIRISConstitution (steward decision 2026-10-18: CC publishes the atom vocabulary; CIRISServer harness/native/model.py loads it)
_meta.source_of_atoms: CIRISServer feat/csd4-catalogue 5c4fdbaa harness/native/model.py ATOMS (51), meanings verbatim
_meta.bump_rule: a new entry, a new atom, a change to an atom's meaning or to an entry's promises bumps catalogue_version; lifting a builder refusal or re-laying nodes that keep every promise does not

root.none.meaning: no canonical serves a root anywhere in the mesh: the node is offline (Just me)

root.key.meaning: a key root (one holder key) is held by a canonical

root.infrastructure.meaning: an infrastructure root (the accord: seated holders, quorum) is held by a canonical

root.rooted.meaning: a canonical holds a root whose lifecycle verdict is rooted

root.two.meaning: two distinct roots are held, by two canonicals

root.halted.meaning: the accord root's kill switch is latched on every node (CC 4.2.1.1)

root.halt_confirmed.meaning: a strict majority confirmed the standing halt within the fuse (CC 4.2.1.3)

root.resumed.meaning: a strict majority resumed the halt; nothing is latched

node.unclaimed.meaning: a node is booted and nobody owns it yet (first run)

node.claimed.meaning: every node a person owns at this point is claimed

node.announced.meaning: some person node announced its owner-binding (placeable)

node.unannounced.meaning: some person node did not announce (P2P only)

canonical.peered.state_predicate: node.serve=serving ∧ record held by every dialing node
canonical.peered.meaning: every node that dials a canonical holds its record (the owner's peering act)

person.multi_device.meaning: a person owns two or more claimed devices

person.outsider.meaning: a person with no relation to anyone else (the negatives' witness)

party.outside_roots.meaning: a node that accepts none of the roots held in the mesh

device.join_requested.meaning: a new device asked to join an existing ID; the other device has not answered

device.join_approved.meaning: the other device approved; the new device verified it offline and HOLDS it, unapplied

device.joined.meaning: the approval was applied: the new device is claimed under the existing ID

peer.direct.state_predicate: peering relation both ways (no table state; transport)
peer.direct.meaning: two person nodes peered directly (production peering both ways)

pair.rooted.meaning: two people hold a valid root in common (edge's pair verdict)

contact.reachable.state_predicate: row.scope=federation for the node binding, held on the other's node
contact.reachable.meaning: a person's node binding is held on another's node at federation scope

contact.added.state_predicate: contact row admitted (no table state; app relation)

contact.via_code.meaning: a contact was added from the person's contact code

room.self.keyed.state_predicate: ∀ devices: row.scope=self room keyed (key_grant per recipient)
room.self.keyed.meaning: every device of a person joined its self room

room.pair.keyed.state_predicate: member.stage=member for both in a pair room ∧ key_grant each
room.pair.keyed.meaning: a pair room is keyed on both sides

message.delivered.meaning: a message's row and body are on the recipient's node

file.held.state_predicate: blob.custody=held on every device of the person
file.held.meaning: a file written on one device is byte-identical on every other device of the person

file.large.meaning: the file is streamed (chunked), not inline

file.custody_received.meaning: the author's custody names every other device with a delivery receipt

file.withdrawn.meaning: the file was withdrawn; no device serves it

roster.visible.state_predicate: contact lists announced devices: key.membership=member ∧ node.announce=announced
roster.visible.meaning: a contact lists the person's announced devices

note.synced.meaning: a note written on one device reads on the others

session.unified.state_predicate: session:claim names one handler per exchange (no table state)
session.unified.meaning: every device names the same handler for each exchange

household.formed.meaning: a family exists with its first member

household.member.meaning: an invited person accepted and is a member

guardian.bound.meaning: a guardian bond (CC 3.4.13) stands over a child member

child.member.meaning: a child is a member of the household

age.assured.meaning: an age assurance row stands for the child

community.member.meaning: an invited person accepted and is a member

moderator.named.meaning: a member holds the moderator duty

quorum_change.held.meaning: a membership change is proposed and held below quorum

quorum_change.applied.meaning: the held change reached quorum and applied

delegation.chain.meaning: a delegation chain of length >= 2 stands

agent.bound.meaning: an agent is hard-bound to a node

steward.bonded.meaning: the agent's steward holds a signed bond

wa.present.meaning: a Wise Authority is reachable for the agent

values.ready.state_predicate: the actor's values.json is written (runner meta-atom)
